about_the_game:
🍬 Gummy Bear Idle – 3D Model DLC

She still doesn’t want a job—
But now she’s ready to appear in your games, chatrooms, and maybe even your VTuber setup (if you’re brave enough).

🧸 Exclusive 3D Model (VRChat compatible)
🧸 Jelly-smooth pink skin
🧸 Extra soft ears × Extra sparkly eyes × Absolutely zero work ethic

🎁 Bonus: Custom Minecraft Skin included!

No job, just jelly. Now in 3D.

Includes: VRM / Vroid / PNG files
